description: Ministry of Public Administration & Management - Revisions made to to the Sri Lanka Architects' Service Minute published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1877/28 of 28.08.2014
reasoning: This gazette notification contains revisions to the Sri Lanka Architects' Service Minute, detailing promotion criteria, qualifications, and service conditions for architects in the public service. It specifically addresses public service recruitment, promotions, salary increments, and disciplinary matters under the authority of the Public Service Commission, making it clearly fall under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8).
